div.head: Grið 13
div.ab: 7 on Norðengla lage stent, þæt se ðe ofslehð man binnan cyricwagum, he bið feorhscyldig;
And on Norðengla lage stent þæt se ðe ofslehð man binnan cyricwagum, he bið feorhscyldig.
And it stands in northern English law that anyone who slays a man within church walls is to be condemned to death.
Und im Recht der Nordengländer [Dena lage] gilt, dass wer einen Menschen innerhalb der Kirchenmauern erschlägt, er ist das Leben [zu verlieren] schuldig;
And in the law of the northern English [the Danelaw] it holds that whoever kills a person within the church walls is liable [to lose] his life;
